Eisenberg for the Justice Department’s National Security Division and U.S. Attorney Gregory W. Kehoe for the Middle District of Florida.

statements.text: The U.S. Department of Justice is announcing the formation of its Super Intelligence (SI) Task Force (DOJ-SITF). President Trump has made clear that “America stands at the forefront of a new technological revolution in intelligence,” and the Department will be a leader in safeguarding against malicious SI actors.

statements.text: I hereby establish the Department of Justice Super Intelligence Task Force (DOJ-SITF).
